whyThisCompany: I fell in love with Webflow about three months ago, and I’ve never used a tool that made me more excited to create websites. I have a long, you know, lots of experience with WordPress as well as static site generators, but when I started working with the American Jazz Museum and integrated Webflow, it made all the difference in the world. I love the way that CSS styles can be applied quickly and globally, and the way that components work in such an intuitive manner. It has made a huge difference in my ability to be effective in website work by using Webflow.
uniqueValue: May not show them my resume, but I do website stuff all the time. And I've had a ton of extracurricular experience with marketplaces and the creator economy through various side hustles and things I've worked on in my spare time.
memorableNote: When I first started working with the American Jazz Museum, they were really in a tight spot because they had nobody technical on staff, and their website had actually been down for several days. Getting that back up and then learning how to use Webflow to run their web presence was huge for me, and it really opened my eyes to what an excellent modern website builder can do for an organization. And, you know, learning the ins and outs of how to build things in Webflow has made me a much better developer overall because some of the best practices that I've learned from Webflow are now something I can apply in my own projects that don't use a CMS or that I'm coding by hand.
